Lazarus Alliance is a proud Service Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) | CAGE Code: 4PHZ4 | NAICS Codes: 541211 & 541690 | GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) MAS contract 47QRAA22D009A

Lazarus Alliance provides 3PAO assessment and consulting services to meet a variety of stringent government and commercial industry standards. Lazarus Alliance has worked with large and small CSPs assessing or consulting against most FedRAMP baselines and DOD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG) Impact Levels. Leveraging our experienced cybersecurity professionals, advanced OSCAL-ready automation support, and battle-tested process improvement techniques helps organizations achieve compliance requirements more effectively and efficiently. As an independent assessor or trusted advising consultant, Lazarus Alliance will help you meet FedRAMP requirements and shorten the authorization timeline.

Lazarus Alliance delivers 3PAO assessment services, including RAR, initial assessments, annual assessments, significant change request (SCR), penetration testing, and continuous monitoring validation and attestation. We provide full scope support from assessment planning, execution of testing, evaluating risk, and submission of a final report to accompany the complete ATO package. Lazarus Alliance guides organizations through a streamlined and cost-effective path to obtaining authorizations and provide an effective continuous monitoring program to maintain the authorization over time.
